name: dictionary-on-click
description: Firefox dictionary extension — double-click any word for definitions

scripts.ci: npm test && npm run build && npm run lint
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run -s dist --firefox /usr/bin/firefox --firefox-profile .firefox-profile --profile-create-if-missing
scripts.load:
npm run build && echo "
Load in Firefox: about:debugging → This Firefox → Load Temporary Add-on → select:
  $(pwd)/dist/manifest.json
"
